title: Stress Testing a Multimodal Large Language Model Grading Assistant on Kinematics Graph Reading
abstract: arXiv:2611.22726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can recognize graph features yet award credit without sufficient graphical support. This exploratory study examines selected grading outputs for synthetic responses to four kinematics exercises, generated through visual distortion and progressive transformation toward reference graphs. Different model and prompt configurations were used. Some judgments correctly distinguished instantaneous zero velocity from rest over a finite interval and recognized positive curvature. Yet a severely distorted velocity--time graph received full credit despite disconnected and branching traces and an unclear zero-velocity reference. Other submissions graded under the same configuration lost substantial credit. translated_title: 对多模态大语言模型评分助手在运动学图表读取任务上的压力测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）虽能识别图形特征，却可能在缺乏充分图形依据的情况下授予分数。这项探索性研究考察了针对四道运动学练习题的合成作答所选定的评分输出，这些合成作答是通过视觉扭曲以及向参考图的渐进式变换生成的。研究中采用了不同的模型与提示词配置。部分判断能够正确区分有限时间区间内的瞬时零速度与静止状态，并识别出正曲率。然而，一幅严重扭曲的速度-时间图尽管存在不连续和分叉的轨迹以及不清晰的零速度基准，却仍获得了满分；而在相同配置下评分的其他提交作答则被大幅扣分。用于区分有意义特征与绘图瑕疵的数值截断标准，是在缺乏坐标约定的情况下针对未标注数字的图形给出的，这使得精确的部分评分依据不明确。
tldr: 多模态大语言模型评分助手在运动学图表评分中表现不一致：虽能正确识别零速度与曲率等特征，却会给严重扭曲且缺乏清晰依据的图形满分，且部分评分的数值依据不明确。
en_tdlr: Stress-testing a multimodal LLM grading assistant on kinematics graph reading reveals inconsistent scoring: it correctly identifies features like zero velocity and positive curvature, yet awards full credit to severely distorted graphs without sufficient graphical or numerical justification.
